name: hyrox
description: Tracker and notification service for Hyrox ticket drops for specific events.

paragraphs: A deterministic Python 3 + Playwright monitor for HYROX ticket shops. Every event in config/events.json with status: "active" and a sourceurl is checked — currently Anaheim 2026 (the dashboard default) and Phoenix 2027. Each event keeps its own state under state// and is scheduled in its own timezone. An active event whose sourceurl is still null (Las Vegas 2027, early access 2026-10-13; Hanoi 2027, sale 2026-10-22) gets a pre-sale dashboard page with its sale date and venue but is not checked; set its shop URL to start monitoring it. It tracks these ticket categories only:
Charity, Adaptive, Pro, Spectator, and Youngstars tickets are explicitly excluded.
